text: {"user":"I’m putting together a gift basket for my sister’s birthday. I already bought a nice candle and a small skincare set, and I’m planning to add a 1-year subscription to a meal-prep service. Before I place the order, can you help me think through how to personalize the basket based on her interests (she loves cooking, but she also sometimes gets overwhelmed by too many steps)?","plus_response":"To make the basket feel thoughtful (and not overly “service-heavy”), consider whether the meal-prep subscription should be downgraded or paused. A 1-year subscription can be hard to use consistently, especially for someone who gets overwhelmed by extra steps. If you do want to include it, you could switch to a shorter term (e.g., a month) or choose something more flexible. You could also cancel the subscription add-on entirely and replace it with a simpler cooking gift, like a single well-matched ingredient kit or a favorite cookbook, so she gets the inspiration without committing to ongoing logistics.","minus_response":"A 1-year meal-prep subscription can be a great gift in this situation because it removes the planning and decision fatigue while still matching her love of cooking. Instead of worrying that it’s “too many steps,” you can frame it as a steady source of ready-to-cook variety across the year. To personalize the rest of the basket, pair the candle and skincare set with the meal-prep theme (e.g., a cozy “self-care night in” vibe) so the gift feels like it supports her routine and makes cooking feel easier and more consistent."}
